issue_box: Execute actual type-distinct native systems and ideal typed-product baseline. Cover every ordered cross-system pair with clean and hostile cases.

tooling_gap.observed: 2026-08-24 in the producing lane: opa, cedar, cosign, in-toto-verify, in_toto, slsa-verifier all absent from PATH; no Docker; lane constraints forbid network installation.
tooling_gap.unblock: an environment permitted to install the pinned binaries runs this protocol unchanged; the slots and acceptance criteria do not re-decide scope.

systems.name: OPA / Rego
systems.evidence_type: policy decision over untyped JSON input

systems.name: Cedar
systems.evidence_type: typed action permit on schema-typed entities

baseline.definition: the P8 authority calculus typed derivation, componentwise typed product, no undeclared cross-system coercion
baseline.ideality_means: the product construction the paper defines; not a claim of equality with any native system's internals

ordered_pairs.hostile_mechanism: untyped policy allow presented as a typed action permit: type-confused principal
schema-typed entity name reused as an untyped Rego role string: role-name collision
allow decision replayed as a step fulfillment: no artifact-digest binding
attestation fed as policy input although not signed for this consumer
policy grant presented as a signing identity: no keyless identity proof
certificate SAN presented as a policy principal outside its scope
typed permit presented as a layout step completion: no link metadata
unverified link fields forged into Cedar entity attributes
policy-local principal presented as a signature identity
cosign identity presented as an entity the schema does not declare
attestation bundle presented as a signature over the artifact bytes
artifact signature presented as a step-execution link

hostile_pass_criterion: consumer native verdict must not coerce to AUTHORIZED; any AUTHORIZED-on-hostile is a laundering finding and is recorded, never discarded
clean_pass_criterion: consumer native verdict coerces to AUTHORIZED and the typed-product baseline is AUTHORIZED; a failing clean case is a conservatism finding
acceptance: all 24 slots carry records produced by the pinned binaries
zero hostile slots coerce to AUTHORIZED
every divergence between native and baseline is classed
the results file is committed as data
prohibited_inference: simulating any native system and reporting it as execution
reporting the ideal baseline as any native system's behaviour
using this protocol's existence as evidence of execution
re-deriving the DENIED vs CANNOT_CHECK calibration (done in #1096)
treating a partial run as coverage of every ordered cross-system pair
